title: Represented epimorphisms give local lifts on the pro-etale site in their value universe
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u and mu:A to B a morphism of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Assume the induced map between represented Type-u-valued sheaves is an epimorphism. For every site object T and map g:T to B, there is a covering sieve S on T such that every f:V to T in S admits t:V to A with t mu=f g. The epi hypothesis stays in the represented-sheaf universe; it is not replaced by an epimorphism of universe-lifted sheaves.

source.place: Tag 00WN, epi/local-surjectivity criterion, with the pro-etale site Tag 098K and bounded affine weakly contractible refinements Tags 098I and 0990

proof.text: Cover each affine chart of an arbitrary site object by the spectrum of the same-universe faithfully flat ind-etale w-contractible algebra supplied by the closed source theorem exists_isWContractibleRing. Compose the singleton spectrum covers with the affine open cover. The fixed resulting covering family has index type in Type u. The private helper exists_open_refinement_cover retains the geometric property needed below instead of only the abstract evaluation-surjectivity property of the earlier covering-family node.

source.place: exists_isWeaklyContractible_cover, using exists_isWContractibleRing from RingTheory/ProEtale/WContractible.lean (Stacks 0983 and 0990)

proof.text: For W isomorphic to Spec R with R w-contractible, a covering sieve contains a finite affine weakly etale surjective cover. Its finite scheme coproduct is affine and its map to W has a section by the closed source theorem exists_comp_eq_id_of_isWContractibleRing, whose algebraic proof uses IsWContractibleRing.exists_retraction. Pull back the open component inclusions of that coproduct along the section. This gives a small family of open subschemes of W that covers W and whose arrows belong to the original sieve. The private open-refinement helpers formalize this geometric part of the existing isWeaklyContractible_of_iso proof, including the empty case.

For a Type-u presheaf P, form the ordinary Type-(u+1) sheafification G of its universe lift, with locally surjective unit eta. On each W of step 1, encode s in G(W) by the set of all pairs (O,p), with O an open of W and p in P(O), for which eta(p)=s restricted to O. This code has type in universe u. If two codes agree, apply step 2 to the image sieve of eta at the first section. Its covering open refinement gives equal restrictions of the two sections, hence equality by separatedness of G. Thus the encoding is injective and G(W) is u-small. On an arbitrary object, restriction along the fixed u-small cover of step 1 injects G(U) into the product of the G(W_i), so G(U) is u-small as well. All unit-local-surjectivity and sheafification facts are applied in Type-(u+1), where Mathlib supplies them.

source.place: Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify and imageSieve_mem; section-code size argument formalized here, refining the same-value-universe step of this node

proof.text: Shrink these objectwise-small sheafifications to Type u. Transport their sheaf property along the component equivalences and reflection of limits by the fully faithful universe lift. Shrinking morphisms gives a functor; shrinkSheafIso gives its natural comparison with the large sheafification. Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful restricts the large sheafification adjunction to this functor. The comparison and reflection of finite limits descend left exactness, giving HasSheafify (topology X) (Type u). Every shrinking is of an already constructed object, and there is no data chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

source.place: Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful, together with Limits.preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves and the proved private shrinking helpers

proof.text: Install the proved Type-u HasSheafify locally. Apply Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi to the original represented map, retaining its original Type-u epi hypothesis. Choose Presheaf.imageSieve of g. It is covering by imageSieve_mem, and its membership witness is definitionally a morphism t with t followed by mu equal to f followed by g. This proves the unchanged conclusion. Isomorphisms and empty objects require no extra hypotheses or case exclusions.

proof_origin.place: C3 proof: retain open refinements from the existing Stacks 0990 geometry, bound the ordinary larger sheafification by injective local-representative codes, restrict its adjunction using Mathlib Adjunction.Restrict, then use the Type-u set-sheaf epi criterion. The theorem and all private helpers compile with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

from.place: Bounded-below hypercover descent: the represented matching-map epi criterion in the actual value universe

lean.statement:
theorem representable_epi_local_lifting
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A B : X.ProEt} (μ : A ⟶ B)
    (hμ : Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map μ)) (T : X.ProEt) (g : T ⟶ B) :
    ∃ S : Sieve T, S ∈ topology X T ∧
      ∀ (V : X.ProEt) (f : V ⟶ T), S f → ∃ t : V ⟶ A, t ≫ μ = f ≫ g
